question: Who founded Trinamool Congress in 1998 and became its Chairperson, after separating from the Indian National Congress?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mamata Banerjee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mamata Banerjee founded the All India Trinamool Congress (AITC) in 1998,** after separating from the Indian National Congress.
 
• She became the **party's chairperson and has played a pivotal role in its growth and success in West Bengal, India.**
